rows.limitations: A pricing deadline is an uncertified CG endpoint; a completed MIP proves only its saved finite pool. Selector equivalence requires matching exact terminal status and normalized routes. Since k=1 selects one route, this diagnoses pricing behavior rather than multi-route charger contention.
rows.notes: Matched k1 pricing-boundary diagnostic: flat prices, capacity arm, 240 kWh initial energy, zero reserve, 13200 s CG, and 600 s finite-pool MIP for both reference and prefix-memo selectors.
